status_note: Banned from September 29, 2026: Proclamation 11061 excludes Canadian wine in bottles of 2 L or less (HTS 2204.21.50, which includes icewine 2204.21.50.28) from import into the US. Until then, a 50% Section 338 tariff applies (heading 9903.03.12) with no CUSMA exemption.
notes: HS 2204.21 covers all bottled wine; market size is the wine market, not icewine specifically.
tariff_note: 50% Section 338 tariff (heading 9903.03.12, no CUSMA exemption) until the import ban starts on September 29, 2026.
